description: Hydropower Cascade Integration in a unit commitment and economic dispatch model: A Comparative analysis of Model formulations is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Alizon Triny Huallpara, Sergio Balderrama (Universidad Mayor de San Simón). This dataset accompanies the article “Hydropower Cascade Integration in a unit commitment and economic dispatch model: A Comparative analysis of Model formulations” and contains input data used to model the Bolivian power system with a strong share of hydropower generation. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
